findings.claim: After Ignatius the sacramental side is represented only by Lateran IV, a council the East does not recognize; the Eastern teaching of the change by the epiclesis, which directly answers statement 4's "beyond a symbol", is absent.
findings.evidence: Cyril of Jerusalem, Mystagogical Catecheses 4-5 (c. 350); John of Damascus, Exact Exposition IV.13 (c. 743): the bread and wine are "not merely figures... but the deified body of the Lord itself", changed "through the invocation and coming of the Holy Spirit".
findings.fix: Insert after Ignatius: {"when": "c. 743", "what": "John of Damascus, Exact Exposition IV.13: the bread and wine are changed by the invocation of the Holy Spirit; not a figure but the very Body."}
